title: Sign off the stack decision record (HPSMPOC-16)?
bluf: Narrowed: of the four early-plan tickets, HPSMPOC-19 (Figma flows) and -20 (prototype approval) are already ruled (hpsmpoc-m2-ux-format a: the coded prototype is the UX; hpsmpoc-m2-signoff-recorded-1023 a: approval recorded), and -35 still waits on the expert content of HPSMPOC-31, so it is not overtaken. One real question: HPSMPOC-16 records the stack against SOW 4.1; its decision record holds 36 ADRs (7 ruled, 29 decided within delegation, per the 24 Sep comment) but is not signed off and the deviations from 4.1 were not listed in one place on 27 Sep (UNMEASURED since). Option A: Tuesday gathers the deviations list from the records and brings it for your sign-off; nothing in Jira changes. Default if you do not tap: option A, at 10:00 AEDT today (2026-11-10).
